display_long_description:
What's New in This Update:

Custom properties overrides (like opacity switch or object colliders) & recoloring: you can adjust these per object or per object class
Passthrough login: Now you can log in comfortably. Enter your passcode while seeing your PC screen without lifting the headset. 
Optimized streaming & faster loading: With large placeholders pre-loading during startup, we've significantly sped up the model loading process. The experience feels smoother. 
Improved lobby experience: The lobby now includes more accurate animations for features on the columns → a more dynamic feel. 
UI Face-lift: We’ve refreshed the UI with new pointers, a redesigned teleportation target, and a direct mini-pointer on the controllers for easier navigation.
Updated minimodel in the lobby: The updated minimodel now has a more user-friendly and visually appealing interface.
Controller hints 

Why BIM VR?

Real-Scale Immersion
Traditional 2D or even 3D screen-based BIM viewers limit spatial understanding. BIM VR solves this by placing users directly inside the project environment. This immersive perspective makes it easier to comprehend scale, proportions, and spatial relationships.

Early Detection of Issues
Teams can spot design clashes, inconsistencies, or construction conflicts long before physical construction begins. This early detection minimizes costly reworks. 

Enhanced Collaboration
BIM VR enables virtual walkthroughs that stakeholders can attend from anywhere in the world.
